template.name: Chison ECO 3 Ultrasound Installation Test
template.desc: Converted from the CHS Ansur template “0000-Chsion ECO 3 - 00000000  Install Test Report DD.MM.YYYY.mtt” (file name). Electrical safety to AS/NZS 3551:2012+A2. Changed from Ansur: earth leakage NC 5000, ON 10000 µA (B11.6) (Ansur: NC 500, ON 1000 µA); enclosure leakage NC 100, ON 500, OE 500 µA (Ansur: NC 500, ON 100, OE 500 µA); 1 repeated step left out (“Protective earth resistance” twice in the Ansur file; the fuller copy kept). Not checked against a manufacturer manual (the Mindray Animal manuals folder has none for this model): the checks and the applied part type are as in the Ansur template, for Jonathan to confirm against the device label and the service manual.

steps.title: Mains voltage
steps.instructions: Plug the ESA612 into the mains supply you are testing from.

steps.title: Protective earth resistance
steps.instructions: Connect the device’s mains lead to the ESA612 equipment outlet. Clip the red test lead to an exposed earthed metal part, such as a rear-panel screw.

steps.title: Insulation: mains to protective earth
steps.instructions: Connect the device’s mains lead to the ESA612 equipment outlet and switch the device on. Don’t touch the device during the test.

steps.title: Earth leakage
steps.instructions: Connect the device’s mains lead to the ESA612 equipment outlet. The device will be switched on and off between conditions.

steps.title: Enclosure leakage
steps.instructions: Connect the device’s mains lead to the ESA612 equipment outlet. Clip the red test lead to an unearthed part of the enclosure.

steps.title: Probes
steps.instructions: Check general condition of probes. Inspect scan head and connector for physical defect. Check for no exposed cable sheath or damage to probe cable. Perform test scans to check for scan defects such as crystal dropout.

steps.title: Battery
steps.instructions: Check battery condition. Check battery charges to 100% and unit runs on battery. Test battery within parameters.

steps.title: Unit
steps.instructions: Check general condition of unit. No damage to case or connectors. No missing keys. No missing screws etc

items: Unit case not cracked or damaged
All Buttons and Knobs Present and Functional

steps.title: Functionality
steps.instructions: Test functionality of unit. Test scan modes, image acquisition. Test, saving deleting, export etc. Check license codes present. Set time zone and customer details. Activate unit.
